scope: Educational information lifecycle; no radio transmission or hardware control
principles: Code defines meaning and procedure; radio waves are the physical carrier.
Modulation is the modeled bridge between bits and a physical waveform.
Validation and integrity checks must occur before and after transport.
A channel simulation is not a live radio measurement.
Positive modeled link margin does not prove transmission permission, safety, or field reliability.
No engine may transmit, tune, key, or actuate radio hardware through this framework.
darma_rules: Use this lifecycle when explaining communications metaphors or music transmission.
Separate information meaning, encoding, transport, and receiver interpretation.
Never claim that a modeled packet was physically sent.
